Cable routing got messy? Cable Anchors keep things tidy without forming unwanted network connections.

Place a §6Cable Anchor §fon any ME Cable face and the cable visually attaches to the adjacent block without forming a network branch. Purely cosmetic, purely useful.

Craft 3 anchors from an ingot and a knife. Works with any metal ingot in the AE2 quartz ingot tag.

Fun fact: anchors act as ladders. Place one on a wall and you can climb it. Free vertical shaft access if you are short on resources.

§ePS:§f Anchors work on glass, covered, smart, and dense cables but not on ME Controller or ME Drive faces. Use them to route cables along facades without creating extra branches.
